===============================

.. py:module:: reworked_diffusion_policy.utils

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Utility helpers for training and evaluation.

Module Contents

.. py:function:: set_seed(seed: int) -> None

   Seed Python, NumPy and PyTorch RNGs for reproducibility.

   :param seed: Seed value forwarded to all RNGs.


.. py:class:: ExponentialMovingAverage(model: torch.nn.Module, decay: float)

   Maintains an exponential moving average copy of a model.


   .. py:attribute:: decay


   .. py:attribute:: ema_model


   .. py:method:: update(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None

      Blend ``model`` parameters into the EMA copy in-place.

      :param model: Source model whose parameters should be tracked.



   .. py:method:: state_dict()

      Expose the EMA model state for checkpointing compatibility.

      :returns: State dictionary mirroring :meth:`torch.nn.Module.state_dict`.



   .. py:method:: to(device: torch.device | str) -> ExponentialMovingAverage

      Move the internal EMA copy to ``device`` and return ``self``.

      :param device: Target device.

      :returns: ``self`` for fluent chaining.



.. py:function:: mse(pred: torch.Tensor, target: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor

   Return the standard mean squared error between ``pred`` and ``target``.

   :param pred: Predicted tensor.
   :param target: Ground-truth tensor of matching shape.

   :returns: Scalar tensor containing the MSE value.


.. py:function:: visualize_trajectories(point_cloud: torch.Tensor, gt_actions: torch.Tensor, pred_actions: torch.Tensor, *, point_size: float, axes_length: float, axes_radius: float, visualize_indefinitely: bool = False) -> None

   Launch a viser viewer comparing ground-truth and predicted trajectories.

   :param point_cloud: Observation tensor with shape ``(T, N, C)`` including points
                       (and optionally colours).
   :param gt_actions: Ground-truth action trajectory.
   :param pred_actions: Predicted action trajectory.
   :param point_size: Rendering size for individual points.
   :param axes_length: Length of pose axes in the viewer.
   :param axes_radius: Radius of pose axes cylinders.
   :param visualize_indefinitely: Keep the viewer open until interrupted when ``True``.


.. py:function:: log_pointcloud_wandb(*, wandb_run, point_cloud: torch.Tensor, gt_actions: Optional[torch.Tensor], pred_actions: torch.Tensor, tag: str) -> None

   Log a combined point-cloud plus action targets to wandb.

   :param wandb_run: Active Weights & Biases run or ``None`` to skip logging.
   :param point_cloud: Observed point cloud tensor of shape ``(T, N, C)``.
   :param gt_actions: Optional ground-truth actions.
   :param pred_actions: Predicted actions to visualise.
   :param tag: Prefix used when naming the logged artifact.
